name: The Star, the Hand and the Heart

angles.text: As a warlock, you seek Yagyin's Digest to gather a new flock and extend your order's occult mastery.
As an undead, you find Keeper Bel'dugur in the Undercity, where he guides Forsaken practitioners seeking forbidden rites.

faq.answer: Keeper Bel'dugur lives in the Undercity and aids members of his dark brotherhood. He guards potent lore and asks candidates to prove their worth before entrusting them with sacred texts.
Yagyin's Digest is a work of ritual lore needed to found a new chapter or gather followers within a secretive occult order.
Bel'dugur asks for three items of power. He writes their names on a private note because he will not speak them aloud.
faq.q: What items does Keeper Bel'dugur ask for?

aliases: why can't bel'dugur say the item names
faq.answer: Bel'dugur will not speak the names of the three relics aloud. Their peril or sacred significance calls for discretion.
faq.q: Why are the names of the requested items not spoken aloud?

aliases: what does gathering a flock mean
faq.answer: Gathering a flock means recruiting followers and founding an independent chapter of the brotherhood, ready to guide other practitioners.
faq.q: What does it mean to gather another flock?

aliases: where does this quest take place
faq.answer: The story centers on Keeper Bel'dugur in the Undercity, the subterranean Forsaken capital.

keywords: the star the hand and the heart

sections.body: Practitioners who hope to lead their own circle come to Keeper Bel'dugur in the Undercity. To found a chapter and gather followers, they need Yagyin's Digest, a work of ritual lore in his keeping. Bel'dugur will aid a brother, but first he asks for proof of worthiness before entrusting him with such knowledge.
sections.title: A Test of Brotherhood

sections.body: Keeper Bel'dugur asks for three items of power in exchange for Yagyin's Digest. Their names carry peril or sacred weight, so he will not speak them aloud. Instead, he writes them on a private note. Finding all three proves a practitioner worthy of founding a chapter of their own.
sections.title: The Unspoken Relics

summary: In the Undercity, Keeper Bel'dugur tests those who seek to lead their own circle. To found a new chapter, they need Yagyin's Digest, but he asks for three unnamed items of power.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Star, the Hand and the Heart
